newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND AXE TWO PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND AXE TWO PLAYERS.

text.p: Scotland have axed Eric Peters and Damian Cronin from their squad for the Five Nations international against Wales at Murrayfield on January 18.
"The hard fact is that Peters and Cronin have been dropped," team manager Arthur Hastie said. "The selectors felt that they have been under-performing."
The only player not considered was the Gloucester flanker Ian Smith who broke a thumb last weekend.
"The hope is that he will be available for the next three matches," said Hastie.

The selectors have taken the unusual step of not naming a captain. But it seems certain to be a straight choice between Rob Wainwright, who returns after injury, and Gregor Townsend, who was at the helm for the three matches before Christmas.

Backs: G. Armstrong (Newcastle), C. Chalmers (Melrose), R. Eriksson (London Scottish), S. Hastings (Watsonians), K. Logan (Stirling Co), B. Redpath (Melrose), R. Shepherd (Melrose), A. Stanger (Hawick), D. Stark (Melrose), G. Townsend (Northampton).

Forwards: G. Ellis (Currie), D. Hilton (Bath), K. McKenzie (Stirling Co), S. Monroe (GHK), A. Reed (Wasps), T. Smith (Watsonians), M. Stewart (Northampton), R. Wainwright (Watsonians), M. Wallace (GHK), P. Walton (Newcastle), G. Weir (Newcastle).
